attributes.name: announcement bar presence and form
attributes.definition: How the announcement/notice is presented on the page.

values.definition: A horizontal bar/strip spanning the page width (top or under nav).
A modal, popup or boxed notice.

attributes.name: announcement bar color treatment
attributes.definition: The color scheme of the announcement bar.

values.definition: Bar filled with a non-neutral colour.

attributes.name: announcement bar link or badge styling
attributes.definition: Inline treatment of the notice's link or label within the bar.

values.definition: Notice text or link is underlined.
A pill/badge label in uppercase precedes the notice.
No special link or badge styling.

attributes.name: announcement bar position and header tiering
attributes.definition: Where the bar sits relative to the nav and how many header tiers exist.

values.definition: Bar is the first element at the top of the page.
Bar sits below the main nav.

values.value: one tier among multiple header tiers
values.definition: Bar is the top of a multi-tier header with utility bar and main nav.
